description: Stay in this bright 61 m² (657 sq ft) Lavie Maison apartment, ideally located on a first floor (with elevator) in the Beaubourg district, in the heart of the Marais. Perfect for up to 8 guests, it features 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms (including one with a whirlpool bathtub), a fully equipped kitchen, and all the amenities needed for a comfortable stay. Just minutes from the Centre Pompidou and Paris’s main attractions, it is the perfect base for exploring the city on foot.The spaceDesigned to combine comfort and convenience, this apartment offers everything you need for a pleasant stay in the heart of Paris. It features 2 comfortable bedrooms with double beds and 2 modern bathrooms, one with a whirlpool bathtub and the other with a shower, making it ideal for families, groups of friends, or business travelers.The welcoming living room, equipped with a sofa bed for two guests, is perfect for relaxing after a day of exploring. The fully equipped kitchen allows you to prepare meals with ease. A television, heating, washing machine, dryer, iron, hairdryer, and toiletries are also provided to ensure a comfortable stay.Accommodating up to 8 guests, this street-facing apartment is the perfect base for exploring the district, strolling through the charming streets of the Marais, and walking to Paris’s most iconic landmarks.Guest accessLocated on a first floor with elevator, you will have access to the entire property and all its facilities. Check-in is self-service via a connect lock, offering you great flexibility and easy access. Located in a secure building in the heart of the Marais, the apartment guarantees comfort and peace of mind throughout your stay. You’ll enjoy a completely private space, designed to make you feel at home from the moment you arrive.Other things to note-

enrichment.summary: Bright, contemporary 61 m² apartment with three listed bedrooms, a lift, air conditioning and a well-equipped kitchen. Reviews praise the decor, bedding and host responses; two mention early-morning street or rubbish-collection noise. Guests also noted no paper towels and a dark entry hallway.
